items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: and I was working with Kenny Anderson

ctx.x: ...then, at the end of high school, what kind of decision did you have? I mean what things did you think of doing and what were other things that were possible for you?

Well I found out from playing around and then, when we were in school, we'd go to these various cities and play and I heard other musicians and I felt that, uh...I discussed this with my father, I see he wanted me to go on to college. I said, "Well look, I think I want to go on out here," you know, and we discussed it and my first little jobs out of town were all right, people liked me and so it gave me encouragement to carry on. And so, my first job, after we discussed it--he said, "Allright son, go ahead,"--was…
Now this is a change then from the person that was the head of the band that you had in high school? This was Kenny Anderson?
